final: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) as outpatient_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) as inpatient_count, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND Admission = '+' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) as outpatient_to_inpatient_ratio FROM Patient
